chunks: And he was asked about images that are on a carpet, having two eyes, while you are performing salat (prayer).
So he said: "If it has one eye, then there is no harm; but if it has two eyes while you are performing salat (prayer), then no."

key_terms.اَلتَّمَاثِيلِ: images or figurative forms depicted on an object
key_terms.اَلْبِسَاطِ: the carpet or spread on which one may pray
key_terms.عَيْنَانِ: two eyes, indicating a complete animate depiction
key_terms.فَلَا: an expression of disallowance in this context
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or legal objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) on a carpet that has images with eyes?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about praying in the presence of depicted forms on a carpet. It distinguishes between an incomplete image and a complete one, indicating no harm in the former and disallowance in the latter during salat (prayer).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.741 – He, Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), was asked about images on a carpet that have two eyes while you are praying.
Imam (as) said: "If it has one eye, then there is no harm, but if it has two eyes and you are praying, then it is not permissible."
